summary: Holocene's read-only Wax tab shipped to production over the HeyMa control surface. Holocene holocene caeb75b..aac0916: read-only Wax tab over the safe discovery catalog, frozen-graph/recent-runs/worker-freshness view, and recent runs showing reason codes only with a busy-state worker strip. The API route /api/modules/wax/catalog reads `wax catalog --json` from the live HeyMa checkout (/home/delorenj/HeyMa), allowlist-projects the payload (no env, no command bodies, no stderr), caches within a TTL, and reports a DOWN source on CLI failure rather than healthy emptiness. Deployed and verified live: @holocene/api typecheck + 63 tests pass (7 wax); holocene-api.service rebuilt and restarted (dist 2026-10-16 16:22, /health ok); holocene-web force-restarted under compose project 33god-platform (labels: traefik Host holocene.delo.sh), rebuilt Next on start, healthy after 20s with /wax in the build manifest; authenticated browser check of https://holocene.delo.sh/wax rendered passes (11 registered, 5 enabled), pipeline cards with drift state, and a live worker strip (heartbeat seconds old), zero console errors. Boundary unchanged: Holocene stays read-only — enabling a pass, compiling a pipeline or running one happens only in the Wax CLI or n8n; Wax owns every artifact mutation, receipt, retry and schedule, and n8n can never become a second scheduler. The Wax daemon + n8n adapter deploy in HeyMa is a separate slice owned there and is not claimed here. Parent integration: holocene submodule gitlink a8bdfa9 -> aac0916.
